decisions.question: No reader passed every Phase 1 bar in the 2026-10-30 comparison, so spec A9's rule (the cheapest reader that passes every Phase 1 and Phase 2 bar) can pick none; which reader becomes the default after the Phase 2 comparison?
decisions.recommended: Keep claude-opus-5-5 as the default, as ruled on 2026-10-30, unless it fails a Phase 2 bar (SC-004 to SC-006); then the cheapest reader that passes every Phase 2 bar and does no worse than it on Phase 1's measured bars becomes the default, and the shortfall is recorded.
decisions.alternative: Apply A9 as written and, when no reader passes every bar, leave the default unchanged until the owner rules on the comparison table.
decisions.answer: Keep claude-opus-5-5 as the default, as ruled on 2026-10-30, unless it fails a Phase 2 bar (SC-004 to SC-006); then the cheapest reader that passes every Phase 2 bar and does no worse than it on Phase 1's measured bars becomes the default, and the shortfall is recorded.

decisions.question: In the photo flow, does the member land on the review after a read and open the Details step from the review's Details section, like the other section steps?
decisions.recommended: Yes: after a read the member lands on the review, and the Details step opens from its Details section, as Phase 1's other steps do.
decisions.alternative: Insert the Details step into the photo flow so the member passes through it before the review.
decisions.answer: Yes, as written in the spec.

decisions.question: Are the nutrition limits 10,000 calories, 1,000 grams for each gram value and 50,000 milligrams of sodium?
decisions.answer: Yes, as written in the spec (owner confirmed the Phase 2 defaults in clarify Session 2026-11-16).

decisions.question: Are the proposed tags one free-text field rather than a list?
decisions.recommended: One free-text field of up to 100 characters, in which a member may write several names.
decisions.alternative: A list of separate tag proposals.
decisions.answer: Yes, as written in the spec (owner confirmed the Phase 2 defaults in clarify Session 2026-11-16).

decisions.question: Does the public site's display of category, tags, difficulty and nutrition, and its search filters, stay unchanged?
decisions.recommended: Yes, unchanged: they already show these values once the owner publishes.
decisions.alternative: Change the display or filters in this phase.
decisions.answer: Yes, as written in the spec (owner confirmed the Phase 2 defaults in clarify Session 2026-11-16).

decisions.question: Are the reader's marks left off the stored draft, so the owner sees no mark?
decisions.recommended: Yes: marks are not stored, as in Phase 1; Phase 3 brings import notes.
decisions.alternative: Store the marks with the draft for the owner.
decisions.answer: Yes, as written in the spec (owner confirmed the Phase 2 defaults in clarify Session 2026-11-16).

decisions.question: Which reader is the default after the Phase 2 comparison, given that no reader passed every Phase 1 bar?
decisions.answer: Keep claude-opus-5-5 as the default, as ruled on 2026-10-30, unless it fails a Phase 2 bar (SC-004 to SC-006); then the cheapest reader that passes every Phase 2 bar and does no worse than it on Phase 1's measured bars becomes the default, and the shortfall is recorded.

decisions.question: Does a read send the reading service only the category and tag names with their diet or style group, counted in the spend reservation?
decisions.recommended: Yes: names and groups only, a few hundred characters, counted in the spend reservation, and no member account data.
decisions.alternative: Send more of the site's content, such as descriptions.
decisions.answer: Yes, as written in the spec.

decisions.question: Does picking the value a suggestion already holds count as an edit that clears its mark?
decisions.recommended: Yes, it counts as an edit and clears the mark.
decisions.alternative: Keep the mark when the member re-picks the suggested value.
decisions.answer: Yes, as written in the spec (owner confirmed the Phase 2 defaults in clarify Session 2026-11-16).
